intent: Initial balanced geometry with moderate size and mass, medium sensor size, and five sensors evenly spaced near the front center. This setup aims to provide stable line detection and maneuverability as a baseline for future improvements.
rationale: Since this is the first iteration, no previous integration feedback or race telemetry is available to diagnose specific issues. Therefore, I propose a balanced initial geometry that fits well within the allowed constraints to provide a stable and general platform for the controller to build upon. The body length and width are set near the middle of their allowed ranges to balance maneuverability and stability. The mass is moderate to avoid excessive inertia while maintaining traction. The wheel radius and track are chosen to provide good ground contact and turning capability. I place five sensors evenly spaced across the front, centered slightly forward on the body to detect the line early and allow smooth steering corrections. The sensor size is medium (0.012) to balance sensitivity and noise robustness. The intent is to establish a solid baseline geometry that should perform reasonably well on the development tracks and provide useful data for future iterations to refine. I request measurements of completion, progress, completion_time, rms_error, and line_loss_events to evaluate overall performance and line following quality in the next race.
